# Cytoscape.js 3.34.4

Unmodified browser bundle and MIT license downloaded from the official
`cytoscape/cytoscape.js` published release `v3.34.4` on 2026-11-10.
Exact source URL and SHA-256 checksums are recorded in `manifest.json`.

This is a presentation dependency of the offline release guide, not an absorbed
skill or an AI classifier. It draws declared nodes/edges and manages layout,
selection, pan and zoom. Builds read verified local bytes and download nothing.
The generated HTML embeds the library and full license so it works on its own.
The vendor directory is also included in every standalone host package.

To update, review the published upstream release and license, replace both files
with their official bytes, update the version/source/checksums, and repeat guide
packaging, offline browser and interaction checks. Never fetch an unpinned bundle
while building or opening a guide.
